market_positioning.target_market: B2B dominant with secondary B2C for high-end individual consumers. Target industries include outdoor recreation equipment retail, law enforcement & public safety supply, hunting gear distribution, security service providers. Primary regional markets are North America, Europe, Oceania, and the Middle East, with strong demand for high-performance outdoor and security optics.

High-end individual customers include professional hunters and expedition guides. Core decision factors: detection range, durability, multi-mode imaging performance, battery life, positioning/ranging accuracy.
market_positioning.price_positioning: Premium. Rationale: The product integrates 3 imaging modes (visible, low-light, thermal) with fusion processing, built-in 4km rangefinder, dual GPS/Beidou positioning, IP65 protection, and extreme temperature resistance (-40°C to 50°C), specs far exceeding mid-range and economy night vision devices.

core_selling_points.title: Tri-Mode Imaging with Fusion Processing
core_selling_points.description: Combines visible light, low-light, and thermal imaging modes with intelligent image fusion, delivering crisp, clear views in all lighting conditions from full daylight to total darkness, ensuring users never miss critical target details.
core_selling_points.evidence: Supports three imaging modes, fusion mode observation distance ≥1200m, daylight image resolution up to 2560×1920.
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Side-by-side comparison of views from each mode and fused view displayed on the product screen, overlayed on the product hero shot.

core_selling_points.title: Long-Range Detection & Integrated Positioning Ranging
core_selling_points.description: Captures clear target views at extended distances, with built-in rangefinder and dual GPS/Beidou positioning to accurately pinpoint target coordinates, ideal for long-distance observation and location recording.
core_selling_points.evidence: Vehicle ranging distance ≥4km, visible/fusion mode observation distance ≥1200m, integrated GPS + Beidou positioning system.
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Graphic overlay showing distance markers and coordinate readout on the device's screen, with a distant vehicle target in the background.

core_selling_points.title: IP65 Waterproof & Extreme Temperature Adaptable
core_selling_points.description: Fully sealed against dust and low-pressure water jets, operates reliably in extreme cold and hot environments, suitable for all outdoor use cases in harsh weather conditions.
core_selling_points.evidence: IP65 protection rating, operating temperature range from -40°C to +50°C, weight ≤2kg with battery for portable carry.
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Product placed under light rain spray, with snowy and desert surface displays side by side to show no damage from harsh conditions.

core_selling_points.title: Real-Time Media Capture & WIFI Transmission
core_selling_points.description: Allows users to capture high-resolution photos and videos of observed targets in real time, and share files wirelessly via WIFI to connected devices for documentation and team collaboration.
core_selling_points.evidence: Supports photo/video recording up to 1920×1440@25fps, integrated WIFI wireless transmission function.
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Graphic showing the device connected to a smartphone, with recorded footage being transferred between the two devices.

core_selling_points.title: Adjustable Magnification & HD Display
core_selling_points.description: Offers optical and digital magnification options for different observation needs, paired with a high-definition display to render sharp, detailed target views without blurring or distortion.
core_selling_points.evidence: Up to 5.8x optical magnification for visible mode, 1x/2x digital zoom, 1600×1200 display resolution.
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Close-up shot of the product's eyepiece, showing a clear, magnified view of a distant target through the display.

core_selling_points.title: Long Battery Life for Extended Missions
core_selling_points.description: Runs for over 6 hours on a single 18650 lithium battery charge, supporting all-day outdoor expeditions or patrol missions without frequent recharging or battery replacement.
core_selling_points.evidence: Continuous working time ≥6 hours at normal temperature, powered by replaceable 18650 lithium battery.
core_selling_points.visual_hint: Product used in an outdoor setting, with a battery level indicator showing remaining charge after 6 hours of continuous operation.
